result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with a high-visibility continental crosswalk and pedestrian signals. While basic infrastructure is present, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming measures increase pedestrian exposure during crossings.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic without a refuge island.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the left side of the street near the crosswalk may obscure pedestrians from oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway near the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to the level of the sidewalk to slow vehicle speeds and increase pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with high-visibility continental crosswalks and pedestrian signals. While basic infrastructure is present, the wide crossing distance and parked vehicles near the intersection create potential visibility and exposure risks for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crosswalk on the right side of the image may block the sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, adjacent to the crosswalk

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Cracking and uneven pavement surfaces near the crosswalk area could present a minor tripping hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, near the start of the crosswalk markings

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to reduce the pedestrian crossing distance and improve visibility by moving pedestrians past the line of parked cars before they cross.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for both pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to the level of the sidewalk to slow traffic and increase pedestrian visibility in this residential context.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with high-visibility continental crosswalks and signalized control, including pedestrian signals. While basic infrastructure is present, the wide roadway creates a significant crossing distance without a median refuge, increasing pedestrian exposure.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to potential vehicle conflicts.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crosswalk spanning the entire width of the street

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The paint on the continental crosswalk is beginning to wear, which may reduce its visibility to approaching motorists.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians mid-crossing.

interventions.title: Crosswalk Refresh
interventions.description: Repaint the high-visibility crosswalk markings to ensure maximum visibility.

result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility zebra crosswalk and vehicle traffic signals within a residential context. However, the environment lacks dedicated pedestrian signal heads and physical traffic calming measures to reduce crossing exposure.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection is controlled by vehicle traffic lights but lacks dedicated pedestrian signal heads, which can lead to confusion about when it is safe to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Visible on the signal poles at the corners of the intersection.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Exposure
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross two lanes of traffic without a median refuge or curb extensions to shorten the distance.
hazards.location_in_image: The full width of the marked zebra crosswalk.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.
